Container.Name: clamav-scanner
Container.Overview: ClamAV scanning daemon for one stack (keystone's uploads). It scans each upload streamed to TCP 3310 and reads its virus signatures from the Signatures folder, which clamav-updater on the same host writes. It never refreshes signatures: CLAMAV_NO_FRESHCLAMD is true, which the image's own README (Controlling the container) documents as the switch that stops freshclam from starting. Signature age is enforced by keystone, not here: keystone refuses uploads when the signatures are older than its limit. NETWORK: set Network to the stack's internal network (for keystone, the network keystone is on), and leave it there. Only containers on that network can reach this daemon, by this container's name on port 3310. There is no internet route on that network. EXPOSURE: this template publishes no port. SIGNATURES: mount the folder clamav-updater writes, read-only, through the Signatures Path. SCRATCH: map the Scratch Path to a folder under /tmp on the host (RAM on Unraid); see the template's own notes. HEALTH: run docker exec clamav-scanner clamdcheck.sh and check the exit status; zero means clamd answers. The image also runs that check itself as its HEALTHCHECK.
Container.Description: ClamAV daemon that scans uploads for one stack. Reads signatures read-only from the host folder clamav-updater writes; scratch in RAM. Publishes no port.

Config.Name: Signatures
Config.Description: REQUIRED. The host folder clamav-updater writes its signatures to, mounted read-only. Use the same absolute path as the updater's Signatures Path, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/clamav-signatures. The scanner never writes here.

Config.Name: Scratch
Config.Description: REQUIRED. A host folder under /tmp, which Unraid keeps in RAM, so clamd's scratch files never reach disk. Use e.g. /tmp/clamav-scanner-<stack> and confirm the host's /tmp is tmpfs.

Config.Name: CLAMAV_NO_FRESHCLAMD
Config.Description: Leave true. true stops the freshclam daemon, so this container never tries to write the read-only signature folder. The updater container refreshes the signatures.
